The '''"AutoTracker" Droid GPS Module''' was a model of [[automap]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. Designed specifically for use in droids, it could be hooked into a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] or [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to allow individuals to access the same information.<ref name="CFTD" />
